title: Kit archived list, version 1
description: One Mac's archived sessions, as the Kit sends them on /mac: the full list (archived) when the server asks with want_archived, then the changes (archived_delta). A session is listed only when it is archived, is not a run of a scheduled task, its conversation is on that Mac, and it has no open Kit wait. Only the folder's own name goes up, never a path. See phone/DESIGN.md, section 13.

rev.description: A hash of the items as the phone sees them.

folder.description: The working folder's own name only (for example src). A slash, a backslash or a tilde means a path, which never leaves the Mac.

archived_at.description: Unix seconds: the API's archive time, else the session's last event.

delta.description: The changes from the list with rev base to the list with rev rev. When the server does not have base, it asks for the full list again with want_archived.

add.description: New or changed items. A changed item replaces the one with the same cse.

remove.description: The cse of each item that left the list.
